**Subject: Introducing Our New Hybrid Work Standard**

Dear Team,

We are excited to announce the implementation of our new Hybrid Work Standard, designed to provide flexibility while fostering collaboration and productivity. This initiative reflects our commitment to adapt our work environment to meet the evolving needs of our employees.

Starting next month, all eligible team members will have the option to work both remotely and in the office. Employees can choose to work in the office up to three days a week, with the remaining days dedicated to remote work. This approach aims to strike a balance that supports individual preferences while ensuring our teams remain connected and engaged.

To facilitate this transition, we will be hosting a series of informational sessions next week to answer any questions and provide guidance on how to make the most of the new standard. We encourage everyone to participate and share their thoughts.

We believe this new hybrid model will enhance our workplace culture, improve work-life balance, and maintain our high standards of teamwork and collaboration. Thank you for your continued dedication and adaptability as we make this important shift together.

Best regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Company Name]

**Internal Announcement: New Hybrid Work Standard**

Dear Team,

We are writing to inform you of an important update regarding our work arrangement for office-based employees. Beginning Monday, January 12, 2027, all office staff at our headquarters will transition to a Hybrid Work Standard. Under this new structure, employees will be required to work on-site three days a week—specifically, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. 

To support this change, we are pleased to announce a monthly parking-and-transit stipend of $60 for headquarters employees. This initiative aims to foster collaboration and strengthen our team dynamics, while still providing flexibility.

Please note that this change does not affect our warehouse and delivery crews, who continue to work on-site daily. Additionally, discussions are ongoing regarding the work arrangements for our 14 remote-only employees hired between 2021 and 2023, and we will share updates as they become available.

We understand that this transition may come as a surprise to some, and we appreciate your understanding as we implement this new standard. Our goal is to enhance teamwork and communication, ensuring Harrow & Vance Supply Co. remains a thriving workplace for all.

Thank you for your attention and continued commitment.

Best,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Title]  
Harrow & Vance Supply Co.
